objective: Train a compact local glyph classifier as a fourth, independent evidence channel for crop-level adjudication before a paid multimodal call.
hypothesis: A compact ImageNet-initialized ResNet-18 trained on every valid MTHv2 train-side character crop plus high/medium-certainty Dunhuang exemplars will beat the existing Gemini 3.6 Flash forced-choice crop adjudicator on the frozen 1,131-instance MTHv2 test-side adjudication pack while retaining at least 95 percent pack coverage.

training.schedule: 3 percent linear warmup then cosine decay
training.loss: cross entropy with 0.05 label smoothing and capped inverse-square-root class weights

data_contract.training: All 2,156 valid content-unique MTHv2 train-side pages after the frozen 80-page-per-corpus development reserve, plus only high/medium-certainty labels from exemplar-labeling-development-v1 whose literal codepoint occurs in the training vocabulary.
data_contract.development: The disjoint 240-page MTHv2 train-side development reserve. It may select the epoch but may not change labels or preprocessing after the run starts.
data_contract.held_out_probe: The 1,131 crop adjudication instances drawn from MTHv2 official test-800 pages. Crops and gold metadata remain local and are never sent to RunPod.
data_contract.normalization: No Unicode codepoint normalization or variant merging.
data_contract.source_terms: MTHv2 non-commercial academic research; acknowledged by the user for this research run.

acceptance.paired_uncertainty: 10,000-sample paired bootstrap confidence interval against Gemini correctness on covered instances
acceptance.decision_rule: Accept only if every held-out hard gate passes. A development score alone cannot accept the classifier.

resource_contract.gpu: one RTX 4090-class GPU with at least 24 GB VRAM
resource_contract.paid_call_authorization: User explicitly requested the RunPod workflow on 2026-07-30.

allowed_changes: library/evaluations/objects/** for accepted immutable checkpoint artifacts
non_goals: No production recipe, candidate, suite, or gold edits.
No bench propose, promote, or canary.
No official test crop leaves the local workstation.
No station integration before the held-out gate passes.
next_permitted_action: Build the full train/development shards on a cost-guarded RunPod pod, train the frozen challenger, retrieve the checkpoint, delete the pod, and score locally on the sealed probe.
